title: NoLoCo: No-all-reduce Low Communication Training Method for Large Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.10911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training large language models is generally done on clusters containing thousands of accelerators, communicating over a high-bandwidth interconnect. Scaling up these clusters is expensive and can become impractical, imposing limits on the size of models that can be trained. Several recent studies have proposed training methods that are less communication intensive, avoiding the need for compute clusters with extremely high interconnect speeds. These low communication training methods still employ a global synchronization step for model parameters, which can be too costly with a high number of participants, as the communication cost scales quadratically with group size. In this work, we propose a novel optimization method, NoLoCo, that does not explicitly synchronize all model parameters during training and does not require any collective communication. translated_title: NoLoCo：一种无需全归约的大模型低通信训练方法
translated_abstract: 训练大型语言模型通常需要在包含数千个加速器的集群上进行，这些加速器通过高带宽互连进行通信。扩展这类集群的成本高昂，甚至可能变得不切实际，从而限制了可训练模型的规模。近期的一些研究提出了通信密集度较低的训练方法，以避免对具有极高互连速度的计算集群的需求。然而，这些低通信训练方法仍需要对模型参数进行全局同步步骤，当参与者数量较多时，该步骤的代价可能过于高昂，因为通信成本会随组规模的平方增长。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的优化方法 NoLoCo，该方法在训练过程中不显式同步所有模型参数，且不需要任何集合通信。NoLoCo 通过一种新颖的 Nesterov 动量变体隐式同步模型权重（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了无需全归约和集合通信的优化方法 NoLoCo，通过 Nesterov 动量的新颖变体隐式同步模型权重，从而大幅降低大规模语言模型训练的通信成本。
en_tdlr: NoLoCo is a novel optimization method that eliminates explicit parameter synchronization and collective communication by implicitly synchronizing model weights through a novel variant of Nesterov momentum, greatly reducing communication costs in large language model training.
